_about: Parameters for detecting rice sowing (flooding) dates from MODIS EVI/LSWI time series (task T3). Used only for regions with paddy rice.

flood_signal.rule: A composite is 'flooded' when LSWI + 0.05 >= EVI.
flood_signal.source: Xiao et al. (2005), Remote Sensing of Environment 95: 480-492 (MODIS paddy rice mapping); applied to 13 Mekong Delta provinces by Tran Thi Hien & Vo Quang Minh (2014), Can Tho University

green_up.rule: The flooding is accepted as rice establishment if EVI reaches half of the crop-cycle maximum within five 8-day composites (40 days) after the flood signal.
green_up.source: Xiao et al. (2005), Remote Sensing of Environment 95: 480-492

app_assumptions.note: App assumptions (not from a source): a crop cycle must peak at EVI >= 0.35 to exclude permanent water and bare soil; two detected sowings closer than 60 days are merged into one season; a composite is used only if at least half of the 3x3 km window is cloud-free; a detection more than 60 days from every configured sowing date is listed as 'unmatched' (possible extra crop or artefact) and left out of the medians, and a ground report is compared only with a detection within 60 days.

Ben_Tre_DBSCL.text: Ba Tri: Winter-Spring rice sown around 22 Nov 2023 and harvested at the end of Feb 2024.
Ben_Tre_DBSCL.source: Báo Nông nghiệp Việt Nam [Vietnam Agriculture newspaper], 22/02/2024

expected_error_days.text: Published MODIS rice-calendar methods in the Mekong Delta report errors of about 9-18 days (Sakamoto et al.: RMSE 9-12 days; Diem et al. 2021: MAE 15 days, RMSE 18 days for Winter-Spring).
expected_error_days.source: Sakamoto et al., JARQ 43(3); Diem et al. (2021) - abstracts read
